_comment: Single source of truth for the ROI calculator's per-industry 'Average Contract Value' slider. Range = realistic single-transaction band for the industry so the client can model THEIR real numbers. Default value sits at min + data-no-default + calcTouched guard, so NOTHING is shown as the client's own figure until they drag it (no fabricated current-state). Read by scripts/fix-roi-slider-industry.py AND scripts/clone-blueprint.sh so direct-patch and regenerate stay identical.
_comment_b2b: Industries whose buyers realistically have a LinkedIn lead-gen / social-selling motion. The ROI calculator's 'LinkedIn Leads Added/Month' slider (which feeds the headline revenue lift) is ONLY appropriate for these. For trades/retail/consumer-local industries (home_services, food_franchise, retail_firearms, medspa, photography, property_mgmt) a LinkedIn-pipeline lever is industry-inappropriate — same defect class as a $45K avg-contract on a plumber. financial-realism-check.py reads this list for the D7-18 field-relevance check; the template/generator gate that removes/zeros the field for non-B2B is the staged follow-up.
